label: mcl_core_andesite
reference_prompt: Create a close material reference for natural andesite from an old grounded dark-fantasy volcanic region. It is a dense intermediate volcanic stone: fine-grained gray matrix with restrained darker mineral grains, subtle cooled-flow variation and blunt natural fracture. The rock should feel tougher and more homogeneous than granite yet richer than generic gray stone. Use muted medium gray with faint cool green-gray and charcoal mineral variation. Avoid concrete, speckled countertop granite, porous basalt holes, polished slabs or huge cracks. Establish andesite through compact volcanic texture, understated mineral diversity and geological solidity.
